Explicit academic-year context:

Conditional acceptance

All accepted students must provide officially certified copies of their degree certificate. Verification can be done electronically or by sending certified paper documents, according to the UEF instructions. Admission will remain conditional until document verification is complete. Failure to verify documents by 12 June 2026 will result in the cancellation of your conditional study offer.

Your admission is conditional if you apply to UEF with a degree that is not finished during the application period. You must submit officially certified copies of your final degree certificate to the Programme Coordinator by 30 July 2026.

Applicants who complete an IB/EB degree or Finnish matriculation examination in the same spring they apply

If the applicant completes their IB/EB degree or Finnish matriculation examination in the spring of 2026, the final result of selection will be made based on the final grades of the IB/EB/Finnish matriculation examination degree. Eligibility for International Bachelor's degree programmes | University of Eastern Finland. Checking and registering the final grades of applicants whose acceptance is conditional in Studyinfo may change the admission order of all applicants.

Tuition fees and waivers

The annual tuition fee for non-EU/EEA students is 10,000 EUR. There are no tuition fees for students who are citizens of EU/EEA countries or Switzerland. Applicants subject to tuition fees can apply for tuition waivers and scholarships during the university application process by completing the relevant section on the application form. Additionally, degree students are required to pay the Student Union membership fee and the Kela student healthcare fee.

Appeal procedure

If you disagree with the student selection decision, you may apply for a rectification of the decision after the results have been published between 27 May – 10 June 2026 before 3 pm.Appeal instructions.
